description: This file is a shell script containing tests and setup commands for a Git project, specifically for testing the 'split commit-graph' functionality and other related features of Git's commit-graph implementation.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: Defines expected output for reading and verifying the commit-graph; checks the graph read data against expectations.

methods.name: verify_chain_files_exist
methods.description: Verifies the existence of chain files in the commit-graph chain.

methods.name: corrupt_file
methods.description: Corrupts a specified byte position in a file for testing verification failure scenarios.
